concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR‑009 (randomize presentation order of the three detail conditions and record it as a covariate) is not covered by any task. No task mentions order randomization or storing `condition_order` for participants.

Functional Requirement FR‑016 (report the power‑analysis validation against Barnard’s test as a reproducible artifact) has no implementing task. The plan’s mapping table references a task T017 that does not exist in tasks.md.
Success Criterion SC‑001 (measure and report Cohen’s h ≥ 0.30 for false‑memory rate differences) is not addressed by any task. No task generates or records an effect‑size metric.

Success Criterion SC‑003 (measure analysis runtime against the GitHub Actions free‑tier job‑time limit) is missing. No task includes a timing or runtime‑benchmark step for the statistical analysis phase.

Success Criterion SC‑004 (verify that all required dataset variables—complexity scores and outcome measures—are present) is not explicitly covered. No task performs a checklist or validation of dataset‑variable fit.
The implementation plan’s mapping table lists task T017 (Power‑Analysis Report Artifact) but tasks.md defines only T000‑T016. This stale reference creates a mismatch between plan and task list.
